articles.summary: Management Earnings Commentary Available November 17, 2026 EDGEWOOD, N.Y., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CPI Aerostructures, Inc. ("CPI Aero®") (NYSE American: CVU) today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Monday, November 16, 2026. In conjunction with the earnings release, a prerecorded webcast and conference call featuring management's review of third quarter 2026 financial results and an update on the Company's operations will be available beginning at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. The webcast can be accessed through the Investor Relations section of the CPI Aero website at CPI Aero website and will remain available for replay for approximately 90 days. The slide presentation to be used during the webcast will be accessible at the same location before the webcast begins. To listen to the conference call by telephone, please dial (646) 307-1963 or (800) 715-9871
